fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-08-25, a green motorcycle bearing registration number TN-30-ZZ-1083 was found missing from the parking space near Kaveri Park Bus Stand Area. The time of the incident was given as 05:20 on 2025-08-25. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. Ezhilan Palanisamy (9000000181) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a vehicle observation and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken during the night from a residential parking spot.
